digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) numbering and indexing system
propositions: 91 ADR files exist with only 69 distinct numbers; 17 duplicate numbers create 22 collision cases where multiple unrelated ADRs share the same numeric identifier

In-flight Gerrit races and stale-base merges cause most collisions; a pre-merge CI check cannot prevent racy conditions, but per-number marker files in docs/adr/.numbers/ create add/add conflicts that Rebase-If-Necessary cannot auto-resolve
22 duplicate-numbered ADRs must be renumbered to 0070-0091 in ascending landing-date order, with earliest-landed ADR keeping the original number within each collision group

Every ADR cross-reference in docs/ and src/ that names a collision number must be rewritten to the final number of the target ADR (disambiguated by slug, topic, ancestry, or context); stranded references are recorded as UNRESOLVED
A bijection check (CI gate scripts/check_adr_numbers.py) must assert one-to-one marker file-to-ADR mapping, unique markers, and referential integrity of all adr/NNNN-slug markdown links

docs/adr/README.md index grouped by workstream, docs/adr/RENUMBERING.md with old-to-new mapping and per-reference resolution tiers, and moved ADRs carrying "previously numbered" headers provide permanent disambiguation of the collision window
